temporalValidation.method: For each test year, blend an exponential recency estimate with the long-history county mean using only earlier within-crop/year percentiles; no future year enters its prediction.

gate.rule: On identical 2019–2025 rows, 2010–2025 history must improve pooled Spearman and percentile MAE; extended coverage must not decrease.

uncertaintyValidation.method: Crop- and history-count-conditional split conformal absolute-error intervals around the shrunken recency prior.

gate.rule: 2018–2025 pooled coverage must be 77–85% for the 80% interval and 87–94% for the 90% interval; mean 90% width <= 0.55; every crop >= 85% 90%-interval coverage.

spatialTransferValidation.method: For each target county-year, exclude that county and aggregate nearby counties whose priors use only earlier years.

productionBlend.method: Select crop-specific regional shares on development, require crop-region development gains, and retain a crop-specific deviation only after both rank and MAE improve on the stability block.

intervalCalibration.method: Crop/history split-conformal base radii fitted before 2018, with the smallest Census-region safety scales that meet nominal coverage in both 2018-2020 and 2021-2022.

gate.rule: Point-estimate gates pass by crop/year and no Census region regresses rank or MAE; production-specific test coverage remains 80-87%/88-94%; mean 90% width shrinks >=4%; every crop has >=88% 90%-coverage; pooled stability/final coverage remains in bounds; every region has >=90% 90%-coverage in the stability block, then final 80% coverage >=75%, 90% coverage 85-98%, and mean 90% width <=0.70.

Coverage within 100 km >=99%; confirmation and final neighborhood rank must improve and MAE fall; final rank-delta bootstrap lower >0; every crop/year improves both; test coverage 80-87%/88-94%, mean 90% width <=0.60, every crop >=88% 90%-coverage; production blend gate must pass.

spatialTransferValidation.interpretation: Validates regional county-prior aggregation and its uncertainty, not parcel yield, revenue, or purchase returns.
